name: my-claude-skills-as-devops-engineer
description: Claude Code plugins from Puru Tuladhar's everyday DevOps work

plugins.name: better-prompt-suggestions
plugins.description: Makes Claude end every reply with a numbered Suggested next list of exact things to type, best first, so Claude Code's grey prompt suggestion (accept with Tab) offers the best one far more often. Type a number to pick another.

plugins.name: smart-copy
plugins.description: Adds /smart-copy: pick a command, code block, table, URL or path from Claude's last reply and copy it with one key, from a picker above the prompt.
